title: Jaffa Cookies
description: Changes the texture of named cookies to that of a jaffa cake.
body:
![a jaffa cake floating as a dropped item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7aaf9a4bf704200a72bce45e238b0f1ab4d67afb.png)Requires **[CIT Resewn](https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn)**, **[Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads)**, **[Optifabric](https://modrinth.com/modpack/optifabric-modpack)**, or another CIT manager.

Supports the following names: _Jaffa Cake, Delicje, Pims, and Cokopiskoty_.

_Names can be lowercase, or include other words,_ as long as the name includes one of the supported names. 
Example: _"jaffa cake pog"_ works.
This will allow you to include any of your favorite flavors without an update to the pack.
Example: _"cherry delicje"_ works. **_(Hi Nex!)_**

The texture does not interfere with your ability to eat the cookie.
It will work with any mod that doesn't change the cookie inherrantly.
